description: Lakehouse table formats decomposed. Iceberg / Delta Lake / Hudi internals. Manifest files, snapshots, schema evolution, time travel, ACID via atomic commit, hidden partitioning. The mechanisms that bring database guarantees to Parquet-on-S3 data lakes.

sub_mechanisms.name: manifest_file
sub_mechanisms.definition: Iceberg/Delta: metadata file listing data files (Parquet) in a snapshot. Plus stats + partition info per file.
sub_mechanisms.why: Engines read manifest to know what files exist. No directory listing needed. Stats enable predicate pushdown at manifest level. Foundation of metadata-driven query planning.

sub_mechanisms.name: snapshot
sub_mechanisms.definition: Atomic point-in-time view of table. References specific manifest files. Each commit creates new snapshot.
sub_mechanisms.why: Time travel: query previous snapshots. ACID: atomic snapshot pointer swap. Cleanup: drop old snapshots when no longer needed. The transaction unit in lakehouse table formats.

sub_mechanisms.name: atomic_commit_pointer_swap
sub_mechanisms.definition: Commit = atomically swap 'current snapshot' pointer. In S3: rename file (S3 'rename' is copy + delete, requires CAS).
sub_mechanisms.why: How lakehouses get ACID without locking. New snapshot pre-staged; pointer swap is single atomic op. Failed swap → rollback. Concurrent writers detected via CAS failure.

sub_mechanisms.name: time_travel_queries
sub_mechanisms.definition: SELECT ... FROM table FOR VERSION AS OF snapshot_id. Reader picks specific manifest.
sub_mechanisms.why: Debug history, audit, restore. Cost: old snapshots' files retained (cleanup configurable). Used heavily for ML reproducibility, regulatory audit, data quality investigation.

sub_mechanisms.name: schema_evolution
sub_mechanisms.definition: Add/remove/rename columns without rewriting data. New schema in next manifest; readers reconcile.
sub_mechanisms.why: Tables outlive their schemas. Schema evolution = no rewrite required. Field IDs (Iceberg) or ordinal positions (Delta) link physical Parquet to logical column.

sub_mechanisms.name: iceberg_hidden_partitioning
sub_mechanisms.definition: Partition spec separate from column values. Engine derives partition automatically. Querying doesn't require knowing partition.
sub_mechanisms.why: Pre-Iceberg Hive tables: partition was a directory name; queries had to filter on partition column. Hidden partitioning: filter on event_time → engine derives day partition automatically. Cleaner semantics.

sub_mechanisms.name: delta_log_transaction
sub_mechanisms.definition: Delta Lake: JSON commit log in _delta_log/. Each commit appends one JSON file describing changes.
sub_mechanisms.why: Append-only commit log. Reader replays to reconstruct state. Periodic checkpoints (Parquet snapshots of state) bound replay length. Inspired by database WAL pattern.

sub_mechanisms.name: hudi_copy_on_write
sub_mechanisms.definition: Hudi CoW table: updates rewrite affected Parquet files. Snapshots reference different file versions.
sub_mechanisms.why: Simple to query: each snapshot is a set of Parquet files. Cost: rewrite cost on updates. Suited for low-update-frequency analytics.

sub_mechanisms.name: hudi_merge_on_read
sub_mechanisms.definition: Hudi MoR table: updates written to log files; merged with base Parquet at read time (or async compaction).
sub_mechanisms.why: Write-friendly: append to log file. Read penalty: merge log with base. Compaction periodically materialises merged Parquet. Streaming-ingest friendly.

sub_mechanisms.name: vacuum_old_files
sub_mechanisms.definition: Periodic cleanup: drop files no longer referenced by any retained snapshot. Configurable retention.
sub_mechanisms.why: Old snapshots' files accumulate. Without cleanup, storage grows unboundedly. Retention tradeoff: longer = more time-travel + more cost.

sub_mechanisms.name: engine_interoperability
sub_mechanisms.definition: Iceberg + Delta + Hudi readable/writable by multiple engines: Spark, Trino, Flink, Snowflake, Databricks, DuckDB.
sub_mechanisms.why: Format ≠ engine. Lakehouse premise: open format + plural engines. Iceberg has broadest engine support; Delta has best Spark integration; Hudi has best streaming.

sub_mechanisms.name: metadata_table_inspection
sub_mechanisms.definition: Special metadata tables expose snapshots, manifests, history, schema. SELECT * FROM table.snapshots.
sub_mechanisms.why: Operational + debug visibility. See what's in your table without engine-specific tools. Format-defined; works across engines.

derivation_rules.name: atomic_pointer_swap_provides_ACID_on_lake
if: table state is identified by single metadata pointer
then: atomic pointer swap provides commit semantics
derivation_rules.why: S3 + lake storage has no transactional API. Atomic rename (or CAS) of single file gives single-writer semantics. Failed swap = retry. The lakehouse trick: ACID without database server.

derivation_rules.name: snapshot_isolation_via_manifest_immutability
if: each snapshot references specific immutable manifests
then: readers see consistent table state for snapshot's lifetime
derivation_rules.why: Reader picks snapshot at query start; manifest files immutable; reader's view is consistent. Writers create new snapshots without affecting in-flight readers. Same MVCC pattern as relational DBs.

derivation_rules.name: time_travel_enables_reproducibility
derivation_rules.why: ML model trained on snapshot X — reproducible by querying snapshot X. Audit query 'as of last quarter' returns exactly what was visible then. Critical for regulated industries + reproducible ML.

derivation_rules.name: open_format_decouples_storage_from_compute
derivation_rules.why: Iceberg + Delta + Hudi: data sits on S3 (any size). Compute (Spark, Trino, etc.) attaches as needed. The Snowflake-style separation, but with no vendor lock-in. Foundation of modern lakehouse.

derivation_rules.name: MoR_better_for_streaming_CoW_for_analytics
if: workload has high write rate (streaming, CDC)
derivation_rules.why: CoW rewrites Parquet on each update — expensive at high write rate. MoR appends to log file; merges at read. Compaction batches the merge. Hudi's design point.
